title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 4
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: The Secret Doctrine, Volume 4, by H. P. Blavatsky, from the multi-volume edition of her 1888 work. This part continues and concludes Anthropogenesis, with Blavatsky's commentary on the symbolism of the archaic teachings concerning humanity: the sacred animals and the zodiac, the serpents and dragons as symbols of divine wisdom and of the Atlantean adepts, the war in heaven and the fall of the angels interpreted esoterically, the 'Holy of Holies' and the mysteries of sex and creation, the cross and the swastika, the Mysteries of the Hebdomad (the number seven in nature and religion), and addenda on science versus the occult doctrine of human origins. It closes the synthesis of science, religion and philosophy that Blavatsky offered as a revelation of the ancient wisdom religion behind all faiths. Volume divisions vary between editions; check the contents for the sections included.
